sloka: स्थितम् आवृत्य पन्थानम् तयोः भ्रात्रोः प्रपन्नयोः ।अथ तम् समतिक्रम्य क्रोश मात्रम् ददर्शतुः ॥३-६९-३३॥
transliteration: sthitam āvṛtya panthānam tayoḥ bhrātroḥ prapannayoḥ ।atha tam samatikramya krośa mātram dadarśatuḥ ॥3-69-33॥

translations.english: Then the brothers after covering one krosa (2 miles) saw a cruel, fierce, mighty monster named Kabandha looking like a trunk. He had a dreadful appearance and his arms encircled the area.
